notes: An arena with powers is the Roblox battlegrounds format almost by definition, so this is Action on its default shape: one flat bounded floor, sized small for the four fighters the author specified, with the stone colosseum as its dressing. The author's answer that powers are abilities held from the start rather than pickups is the reason powerup-buffs is absent — 'powers' would otherwise have pulled that option in, and it would have scattered buff pads across a floor nobody was meant to hunt on. I also dropped the preset's hazard-kill, because ring-out edges and bottomless drops contradict a walled colosseum; if knock-off is meant to be the win condition, that is a one-option addition at no pipeline cost. Sightline-breaking columns read naturally as colosseum pillars, the run ends by elimination rather than at any placed goal, and I left the surrounding stands as image dressing rather than taking spectator-zone, which keeps the whole build on a plain P0.
